sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the complete Complex readiness contract: it targets the supplied ship owner, reaches the required propeller shaft line components and propulsion load case, identifies the blade-failure case, requires both declared load-case operands, and checks both declared safety-factor results on each component with inclusive decimal minima of 1.0 and the canonical units. No formula execution or additional evidence is required by the contract.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the sh:or alternatives and require the applicable loadCase, identified by shaftLineLoadCaseType nltl:bladeFailureLoadCase, to contain both declared operand quantities nltl:bladeFailureUltimateLoad and nltl:combinedAxialBendingTorsionLoad. The current alternatives allow a blade-failure case to pass with neither operand because the outer blade-failure constraint is satisfied while the extreme-operational or fatigue branches omit the operands. Retain the requiredOwner paths: both operands on the loadCase and both safety-factor results on each nltl:propellerShaftLineComponent. Preserve the inclusive >= 1.0 direct checks and the declared decimal/unit constraints.

The candidate faithfully encodes the complete Complex readiness contract: it targets the supplied ship owner, reaches the required propeller shaft line components and propulsion load case, identifies the blade-failure case, requires both declared load-case operands, and checks both declared safety-factor results on each component with inclusive decimal minima of 1.0 and the canonical units. No formula execution or additional evidence is required by the contract.
